final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vdd vss ibias
* gain device: NMOS common source (wider to keep loop gain with smaller Rd)
M1  vout g     vss vss nfet W=8  L=0.2 m=12
* resistor load (lower value -> higher cutoff-limited output top)
Rd  vdd  vout  700
* shunt feedback network: closed-loop gain ~ -Rf/Rin (loop-gain limited)
Rin vin  g     500
Rf  vout g     1.8k
* sink for the reference current (keeps ibias node defined)
Mb  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
.ends
